attempts.sql:
WITH base_classes AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id
  FROM code.symbols s
  JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
  WHERE s.kind = 'class'
    AND s.is_public = TRUE
    AND f.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/connectors/%'
    AND f.is_test = FALSE
),
subclass_count AS (
  SELECT cb.base_symbol_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cb.class_symbol_id) AS subclasses
  FROM code.class_bases cb
  JOIN code.symbols sub ON cb.class_symbol_id = sub.symbol_id
  JOIN code.files sub_f ON sub.file_id = sub_f.file_id
  WHERE sub.kind = 'class'
    AND sub_f.is_test = FALSE
    AND cb.base_symbol_id IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM base_classes)
  GROUP BY cb.base_symbol_id
),
constructed AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT callee_symbol_id
  FROM code.calls
  WHERE callee_symbol_id IS NOT NULL
    AND callee_symbol_id IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM base_classes)
)
SELECT bc.symbol_id, sc.subclasses
FROM base_classes bc
JOIN subclass_count sc ON bc.symbol_id = sc.base_symbol_id
WHERE sc.subclasses > 0
  AND bc.symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT callee_symbol_id FROM constructed)

request.question:
Which public classes in auto_ontology/connectors are used only as base classes: subclassed by other non-test classes but never constructed by a resolved call? Give the number of non-test subclasses of each.

Hint: code.class_bases records the base classes named in each class statement; base_symbol_id is the internal class a base resolves to. Calling a class name creates an instance.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string), subclasses (integer).

answer.response: The query finds public, non-test classes in the auto_ontology/connectors package that are subclassed by other non-test classes but are never used as a constructor target in a resolved call (no code.calls row has their symbol_id as callee_symbol_id). It counts distinct non-test subclasses per class and returns only those with at least one subclass.
answer.sql_code:
WITH base_classes AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id
  FROM code.symbols s
  JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
  WHERE s.kind = 'class'
    AND s.is_public = TRUE
    AND f.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/connectors/%'
    AND f.is_test = FALSE
),
subclass_count AS (
  SELECT cb.base_symbol_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cb.class_symbol_id) AS subclasses
  FROM code.class_bases cb
  JOIN code.symbols sub ON cb.class_symbol_id = sub.symbol_id
  JOIN code.files sub_f ON sub.file_id = sub_f.file_id
  WHERE sub.kind = 'class'
    AND sub_f.is_test = FALSE
    AND cb.base_symbol_id IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM base_classes)
  GROUP BY cb.base_symbol_id
),
constructed AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT callee_symbol_id
  FROM code.calls
  WHERE callee_symbol_id IS NOT NULL
    AND callee_symbol_id IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM base_classes)
)
SELECT bc.symbol_id, sc.subclasses
FROM base_classes bc
JOIN subclass_count sc ON bc.symbol_id = sc.base_symbol_id
WHERE sc.subclasses > 0
  AND bc.symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT callee_symbol_id FROM constructed)
